```{r}
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly) 

# Age groups to keep
age_keep <- c("15-24 Years", "25-44 Years", "45-64 Years", "65+ Years", "<15 Years")

# Filter dataset
d_filtered <- d4 %>%
  filter(age %in% age_keep)

# Split into 2 datasets by source
d4_epic_cosmos <- d_filtered %>% filter(source == "Epic Cosmos")
d4_cdc_wisqars <- d_filtered %>% filter(source == "CDC/WISQARS")


#Group by Region
library(dplyr)

add_region <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      region = case_when(
        geography %in% c("Illinois", "Indiana", "Iowa", "Kansas", "Michigan", "Minnesota",
                         "Missouri", "Nebraska", "North Dakota", "Ohio", "South Dakota", "Wisconsin") ~ "Midwest",
        geography %in% c("Connecticut", "Maine", "Massachusetts", "New Hampshire", "New Jersey",
                         "New York", "Pennsylvania", "Rhode Island", "Vermont") ~ "Northeast",
        geography %in% c("Alaska", "Arizona", "California", "Colorado", "Hawaii", "Idaho",
                         "Montana", "Nevada", "New Mexico", "Oregon", "Utah", "Washington", "Wyoming") ~ "West",
        geography %in% c("Alabama", "Arkansas", "Delaware", "District of Columbia", "Florida", "Georgia",
                         "Kentucky", "Louisiana", "Maryland", "Mississippi", "North Carolina", "Oklahoma",
                         "South Carolina", "Tennessee", "Texas", "Virginia", "West Virginia") ~ "South",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    )
}

d4_epic_cosmos  <- add_region(d4_epic_cosmos)
d4_cdc_wisqars  <- add_region(d4_cdc_wisqars)

# Remove rows where region == "Other"
#d4_epic_cosmos <- d4_epic_cosmos %>% filter(region != "Other")
#d4_cdc_wisqars <- d4_cdc_wisqars %>% filter(region != "Other")

#Plot graphs
plot_region_ts <- function(df, title) {
  df %>%
    group_by(year, region) %>%
    summarise(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = as.numeric(year), y = value, color = region)) +
    geom_line(size = 1) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Year",
      y = "Value",
      color = "Region"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
}


p4_cosmos    <- plot_region_ts(d4_epic_cosmos, "Epic Cosmos: Opioid-related ED visits by Region")
p4_wisqars   <- plot_region_ts(d4_cdc_wisqars, "CDC/WISQARS: Overdose-related deaths by Region")

ggplotly(p4_cosmos)
ggplotly(p4_wisqars)
```

```{r}
# plots of Overdose Death Rate Trends by State (2015–2025)

d6 %>%
  filter(!is.na(geography), geography != "United States") %>%   # remove NA and "United States"
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = rate_deaths_overdose)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkgreen", size = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ geography, scales = "fixed") +
  labs(
    title = "Overdose Death Rate Trends by State (2015–2025)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Deaths per 100,000"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
## # Rank all states for each year
state_rank_all_years <- d6 %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  arrange(desc(rate_deaths_overdose)) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%   # assign rank to every state
  ungroup() %>%
  select(time, geography, rate_deaths_overdose, rank)

# Save full ranking for Tableau
write.xlsx(state_rank_all_years, "C:/Users/ampof/Desktop/New PopHIVE/Insights/opioid_trends/files for tableau/state_rank_all_years.xlsx")

# Rank all states per year
ranked_states <- d6 %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  arrange(desc(rate_deaths_overdose)) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Filter top 10 per year
top10_trends <- ranked_states %>%
  filter(rank <= 10)

write.xlsx(top10_trends, "C:/Users/ampof/Desktop/New PopHIVE/Insights/opioid_trends/files for tableau/top10_horserace_graph.xlsx") #for tableau

# Filter top 15 per year
top15_trends <- ranked_states %>%
  filter(rank <= 15)

write.xlsx(top15_trends, "C:/Users/ampof/Desktop/New PopHIVE/Insights/opioid_trends/files for tableau/top15_horserace_graph.xlsx") #for tableau
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)

# Function to create faceted ggplot for age groups
plot_age_ts <- function(df, title) {
  df %>%
    filter(geography == "United States") %>%
    group_by(year, age) %>%
    summarise(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = as.numeric(year), y = value, color = age)) +
    geom_line(size = 1) +
      labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Year",
      y = "Value",
      color = "Age Group"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 10)
)
}

# Build the two ggplots
g_wisqars <- plot_age_ts(d4_cdc_wisqars, "CDC/WISQARS: Overdose-related deaths by Age Group")
g_cosmos  <- plot_age_ts(d4_epic_cosmos, "Epic Cosmos: Opioid-related ED visits Trends by Age Group")

# Convert to interactive plotly objects
p_wisqars_interactive <- ggplotly(g_wisqars)
p_cosmos_interactive  <- ggplotly(g_cosmos)

# Display
p_wisqars_interactive
p_cosmos_interactive
```

#Demography data
library(dplyr)

p_sex_national <- d8 %>%
  filter(
    sex %in% c("Male", "Female")
  ) %>%
  group_by(time, sex) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rate = mean(wisqars_rate_drug_poisoning, na.rm = TRUE),

```{r line-example, eval=FALSE}
### Line Graph

library(PopHivePlots)
library(ggplot2)

# Setup fonts
setup_pophive_fonts()

# Sample data
df_line <- data.frame(
  year = rep(2015:2024, 3),
  value = c(runif(10, 20, 50), runif(10, 30, 60), runif(10, 25, 55)),
  category = rep(c("Category A", "Category B", "Category C"), each = 10)
)

# Create line plot
pophive_plot(
  data = df_line,
  plot_type = "line",
  aes_mappings = aes(x = year, y = value, color = category, linetype = category),
  title = "Trends Over Time",
  subtitle = "Example line graph with custom PopHIVE theme",
  caption = "Data source: sample data",
  x_label = "Year",
  y_label = "Value",
  line_width = 0.8
)
```
